# Vendor Overview

The `vendor/` tree contains third-party software that is stored in-tree for convenience or integration.

## Current entries

- `claude-code`
- `yakpro-po`

These are not first-party product repos, but documenting them helps explain why they are present and how they support the broader workspace.
